Sie nennt seine Eltern als George Farr und Alice Beard.

discoveries.headline: Frank Albert Magwire died on October 8, 1967 in Springfield, Vermont, aged 78. His Vermont death record names his parents as Albert A. and Alice, and his wife as Alice B. His obituary in the Rutland Daily Herald (October 10, 1967) names his sons Raymond B., Harold C. and Howard F., his sister Edna Pope and his brother Charles E. Magwire.
discoveries.headline_de: Frank Albert Magwire starb am 8. Oktober 1967 in Springfield, Vermont, im Alter von 78 Jahren. Sein Sterbebeleg aus Vermont nennt als Eltern Albert A. und Alice und als Ehefrau Alice B. Sein Nachruf im Rutland Daily Herald (10. Oktober 1967) nennt seine Söhne Raymond B., Harold C. und Howard F., seine Schwester Edna Pope und seinen Bruder Charles E. Magwire.

source.text: Rutland Daily Herald, 10 Oct 1967 (Ancestry obituary index, record 778673060); Vermont death record, Ancestry record 287189; Find a Grave memorial 208110370 (Oakland Cemetery, Springfield)

discoveries.headline: Alice B. (Bates) Magwire died on March 29, 1972 in Springfield, Vermont, aged 82. Her Vermont death record names her parents as Charles and Ida Bates, and her obituary in the Times Argus (April 1, 1972) names her sister Mary B. Wheelock.
discoveries.headline_de: Alice B. (Bates) Magwire starb am 29. März 1972 in Springfield, Vermont, im Alter von 82 Jahren. Ihr Sterbebeleg aus Vermont nennt als ihre Eltern Charles und Ida Bates, und ihr Nachruf im Times Argus (1. April 1972) nennt ihre Schwester Mary B. Wheelock.

source.text: Times Argus, 1 Apr 1972 (Ancestry, record 837822748); Vermont death record, Ancestry record 287193; Springfield VT cemetery cards (Oakland Cemetery, lot 51)

discoveries.headline: Mary Abbie (West) Farr died on March 5, 1992, aged about 90, then of Schenectady, New York. The Rutland Daily Herald obituary index (March 13, 1992) gives her birth as 1901 in Peru, Vermont, her father as William West and her children as Gwendolyn, Richard and Alma. She is buried in Oakland Cemetery, Springfield, beside her husband Harry.

März 1992) gibt ihre Geburt mit 1901 in Peru, Vermont, an, ihren Vater als William West und ihre Kinder als Gwendolyn, Richard und Alma. Sie ist auf dem Oakland Cemetery in Springfield neben ihrem Ehemann Harry begraben.

source.text: Rutland Daily Herald, 13 Mar 1992 (Ancestry obituary index, record 600189743); Springfield VT cemetery cards (Mary A. Farr, 90 yrs, 1992, lot 128)

discoveries.headline: The Springfield, Vermont, cemetery cards record George Oscar Farr, aged 50, buried in 1911 in Oakland Cemetery, lot 83, tier 1, ward D, a lot bought on April 25, 1911 by Anna L. Farr. He is probably Harry James Farr's father, who by the 1910 census lived in Springfield with a wife Anna L. rather than Harry's mother, Alice Beard.
discoveries.headline_de: Die Friedhofskarten von Springfield, Vermont, verzeichnen George Oscar Farr, 50 Jahre alt, 1911 beigesetzt auf dem Oakland Cemetery, lot 83, tier 1, ward D, ein Los, das Anna L. Farr am 25. April 1911 kaufte. Er ist wahrscheinlich der Vater von Harry James Farr. Laut der Volkszählung von 1910 lebte er in Springfield mit einer Ehefrau namens Anna L., nicht mit Harrys Mutter Alice Beard.

discoveries.headline: The Vermont marriage card for Harry James Farr and Laura Mary Seward (Springfield, December 4, 1912) names the groom's parents as George O. Farr and Alice Beard, but gives her birthplace as Chester, Vermont, while Harry's 1926 marriage card says Andover, Vermont. The two cards disagree on the town.
discoveries.headline_de: Die Heiratskarte von Vermont für Harry James Farr und Laura Mary Seward (Springfield, 4. Dezember 1912) nennt als Eltern des Bräutigams George O. Farr und Alice Beard, gibt als Geburtsort von Alice Beard jedoch Chester, Vermont, an, während Harrys Heiratskarte von 1926 als Geburtsort Andover, Vermont, nennt. Die beiden Karten stimmen beim Ort nicht überein.

source.text: Vermont marriage card, Springfield, 4 Dec 1912 (Ancestry, record 246183)

discoveries.headline: Gwendolyn Lorraine Farr, aged 33, married Howard Frank Magwire on January 7, 1961 in Springfield, Vermont; her parents are given as Harry and Mary Farr. The Connecticut Death Index records her death in Suffield on September 6, 2009 (born July 1, 1927).
discoveries.headline_de: Gwendolyn Lorraine Farr, 33 Jahre alt, heiratete am 7. Januar 1961 in Springfield, Vermont, Howard Frank Magwire; als ihre Eltern sind Harry und Mary Farr angegeben. Der Connecticut Death Index verzeichnet ihren Tod in Suffield am 6. September 2009 (geboren 1. Juli 1927).

source.text: Vermont marriage record, Springfield, 7 Jan 1961 (Ancestry, record 1051029); Connecticut Death Index, 1949-2012 (Ancestry, record 1551946)

discoveries.headline: Harold Charles Magwire died on October 16, 2002 in Ormond Beach, Florida, and is buried in the Vermont Veterans Memorial Cemetery, Randolph Center. He married Shirley Marie Havens in Springfield on June 20, 1940, and Nellie Manks in Springfield on August 4, 1956. His son Thomas H. Magwire's 2021 obituary names Harold and Shirley (Havens) Magwire as his late parents and gives the same cemetery.
discoveries.headline_de: Harold Charles Magwire starb am 16. Oktober 2002 in Ormond Beach, Florida, und ist auf dem Vermont Veterans Memorial Cemetery in Randolph Center begraben. Er heiratete Shirley Marie Havens am 20. Juni 1940 in Springfield und Nellie Manks am 4. August 1956 in Springfield. Der Nachruf seines Sohnes Thomas H. Magwire von 2021 nennt Harold und Shirley (Havens) Magwire als seine verstorbenen Eltern und gibt denselben Friedhof an.

source.text: Social Security Death Index and Find a Grave memorial 24257524 (Ancestry copies); Vermont marriage records 305665 (1940) and 369576 (1956); Hooker and Whitcomb Funeral Home obituary of Thomas H. Magwire, 1 Oct 2021

discoveries.headline: Raymond B. Magwire of Hydeville, Vermont, died on April 26, 1997 in Rutland. His Rutland Daily Herald obituary (April 28, 1997) gives burial at Castleton on May 16, 1997 and names his brother Howard.

source.text: Rutland Daily Herald, 28 Apr 1997 (Ancestry obituary index, record 616593354)
